name: Claw hammer
definition: hammer with a striking face and a curved claw for pulling nails.

name: Japanese hammer
definition: Japanese hammer with two striking faces, one flat and one slightly convex.

name: Mallet
definition: soft-faced or wooden-headed hammer for striking chisels and assemblies.

name: Demolition hammer
definition: Powered tool that drives a chisel or point by hammer blows alone, with no rotation, to break concrete, masonry and tile; air, petrol and electric breakers and jackhammers included.

name: Wrecking bar
definition: flat or round steel bar with a curved claw end for prying and demolition.

name: Nail gun
definition: Tool that drives nails from a strip or coil, powered by air, gas, mains or battery.

name: Staple gun
definition: tool that fires staples into a surface.

name: Rivet gun
definition: tool that sets rivets.

name: MIG welder
definition: welding machine that feeds a continuous wire electrode through a gun with shielding gas.

name: TIG welder
definition: welding machine using a tungsten electrode and a separate filler rod under shielding gas.

name: Stick welder
definition: welding machine that burns coated rod electrodes held in a clamp.

name: Multi-process welder
definition: one welding machine set up to run more than one of the MIG, TIG and stick processes.

name: Soldering iron
definition: hand-held heated tip for melting solder, usually in electrical and electronics work.

name: Soldering station
definition: temperature-controlled power base with a soldering iron handpiece and stand.

name: Glue gun
definition: hand-held electric tool that melts and dispenses adhesive sticks.

name: Heat gun
definition: hand-held electric hot-air tool for stripping, shrinking and softening.

name: Pliers
definition: hand tool with two pivoted jaws to grip, bend or cut.

name: Clamp
definition: tool that presses and holds workpieces together by a screw, bar or lever.

name: Bench vice
definition: jaws fixed to a bench that hold a workpiece.

name: Workbench
definition: work surface made for tool work, with or without vises, dog holes and storage.

name: Sawhorse
definition: trestle-type support pair or single frame carrying a workpiece at working height.

name: Trestle
definition: frame support for a board or workpiece, used in pairs.

name: Tape measure
definition: coiled flexible rule in a case.

name: Spirit level
definition: straight body with liquid vials showing level or plumb.

name: Laser measure
definition: handheld device that measures distance with a laser, for building and trade work.

name: Caliper
definition: sliding gauge measuring outside, inside and depth dimensions.

name: Micrometer
definition: screw gauge for precise outside, inside or depth measurement.

name: Dial indicator
definition: gauge with a plunger or lever and a dial showing small displacement.

name: Height gauge
definition: gauge on a base for measuring or marking height.

name: Hardness tester
definition: instrument that tests the hardness of a material.

name: Coordinate measuring machine
definition: machine that probes a part to measure its geometry in three axes.

name: Marking gauge
definition: tool that scribes a line parallel to an edge.

name: Square
definition: right-angle tool for marking and checking squareness, including combination squares.

name: Multimeter
definition: instrument that measures several electrical quantities for trade and electronics work.

name: Panel saw
definition: hand saw with a stiff, single-edged tapered blade on a handle, cutting on the push stroke (Western handsaw).

name: Hacksaw
definition: hand saw with a thin replaceable blade tensioned in a bow frame, for metal, pipe and plastic.

name: Ryoba saw
definition: thin Japanese hand saw with crosscut teeth on one edge and rip teeth on the other, cutting on the pull stroke.

name: Dozuki saw
definition: Japanese pull saw whose thin fine-toothed blade is stiffened by a steel back, for joinery.

name: Flush-cut saw
definition: Japanese pull saw with a flexible blade and unset teeth that cuts flush against a surface.

name: Circular saw
definition: hand-held power saw with a rotating toothed disc for straight cuts in timber and sheet.

name: Jigsaw
definition: hand-held power saw with a short, vertically reciprocating blade for curves and cut-outs.

name: Oscillating multi-tool
definition: hand-held power tool whose blade, pad or scraper vibrates through a small arc, for plunge cuts, sanding and scraping.

name: Mitre saw
definition: power saw whose blade is carried on a pivoting arm over a table, for crosscuts and angle cuts (sliding and compound are attributes).

name: Jobsite table saw
definition: light portable table saw with the blade rising through a small bench top, carried to site.

name: Hybrid table saw
definition: stationary table saw with a cabinet-style top on a lighter open or part-enclosed base, between jobsite and cabinet types.

name: Cabinet table saw
definition: heavy stationary table saw with an enclosed cabinet base and the mechanism hung from the top.

name: Sliding table saw
definition: table saw with a sliding carriage beside the blade for panels and sheet.

name: Bandsaw
definition: machine with a continuous toothed band running over wheels, for curves, resawing and timber cutting.

name: Metal-cutting bandsaw
definition: bandsaw built for metal, with a fine-tooth band, slow speed, clamping vise and usually coolant.

name: Cold cut saw
definition: machine with a slow-turning circular blade that cuts metal bar and tube cleanly.

name: Scroll saw
definition: bench machine with a thin reciprocating blade held in tensioned arms, for fretwork and intricate curves.

name: Utility knife
definition: knife with a replaceable or snap-off blade for cutting materials in a trade or workshop.

name: Pocket knife
definition: small folding or locking knife carried in a pocket for general cutting (not a weapon blade pattern).

name: Multi-tool
definition: pocket-size tool with pliers and folding implements (knife, scissors, drivers, file, saw) in its handles.

name: Axe
definition: long-handled tool with a bladed head for felling, hewing or splitting wood, of any pattern.

name: Splitting maul
definition: heavy-headed tool with a wedge face on one side and a flat sledge face on the other, for splitting logs.

name: Splitting wedge
definition: steel wedge driven into wood with a hammer or maul to split it.

name: Log splitter
definition: machine (hydraulic or other power, not tractor-driven) that forces a log against a wedge.

name: Hand brace
definition: hand-cranked drill with a sweep handle and a chuck.

name: Drill driver
definition: hand-held rotary tool with chuck and clutch for drilling and driving screws.

name: Hammer drill
definition: Drill driver with an extra hammer action and an ordinary chuck, for drilling masonry and concrete.

name: Rotary hammer
definition: hand-held tool with an electro-pneumatic hammer mechanism and an SDS-type bit holder, for heavy drilling and chiselling in masonry.

name: Drill press
definition: drill on a column with a table and feed lever, bench or floor mounted.

name: Screwdriver
definition: hand tool with a handle and tip that turns screws.

name: Electric screwdriver
definition: small powered driver for light screwdriving, without an impact mechanism.

name: Impact driver
definition: hand-held power driver with an impact mechanism and a quarter-inch hex bit holder.

name: Hex key
definition: bent or T-handled bar with a hexagonal end for socket screws.

name: Combination spanner
definition: fixed wrench with an open end and a ring end of the same size.

name: Adjustable wrench
definition: wrench with a movable jaw set by a screw.

name: Socket wrench
definition: Ratcheting handle that turns interchangeable sockets; socket sets are here too.

name: Torque wrench
definition: wrench that indicates or limits the tightening torque applied.

name: Impact wrench
definition: power wrench with an impact mechanism and square drive for sockets and heavy fasteners.

name: Smoothing plane
definition: short hand plane for final surface smoothing (Stanley No. 1 to 4-1/2 pattern).

name: Jack plane
definition: medium-length hand plane for general stock removal (No. 5, 5-1/2, 6).

name: Jointer plane
definition: long hand plane for straightening edges and faces (No. 7, 8).

name: Japanese plane
definition: Japanese plane with a wooden body and blade set into it, cutting on the pull stroke.

name: Power planer
definition: hand-held electric plane with a rotating cutter drum.

name: Jointer
definition: machine with infeed and outfeed tables and a cutterhead that flattens a face and squares an edge.

name: Thicknesser
definition: machine that planes boards to an even thickness against a bed.

name: Planer-thicknesser
definition: single machine combining jointer tables and a thicknessing bed on one cutterblock.

name: Bench chisel
definition: chisel made to be struck with a mallet, strong tang or socket and hooped or reinforced handle.

name: Paring chisel
definition: long, thin chisel pushed by hand for fine paring.

name: Mortise chisel
definition: thick, deep-bladed chisel struck to chop mortises.

name: Turning gouge
definition: long-handled gouge for shaping wood on a lathe.

name: Mortiser
definition: machine that cuts square mortises with a hollow chisel and auger.

name: File
definition: hardened steel bar with cutting ridges for removing metal or wood by hand.

name: Whetstone
definition: block of natural or synthetic abrasive used with water or oil to sharpen blades (honing guides go with it).

name: Bench grinder
definition: electric motor with grinding wheels on a stand, for sharpening and shaping.

name: Sharpening system
definition: machine or jig system for sharpening edges, such as a slow wet wheel with jigs.

name: Angle grinder
definition: hand-held power tool with a disc on a right-angle head, for grinding and cutting.

name: Die grinder
definition: straight-bodied high-speed hand tool for burrs and mounted points.

name: Rotary tool
definition: slim hand-held high-speed motor with a collet or chuck for small accessories (engraving, cutting, sanding, polishing).

name: Random orbital sander
definition: hand-held sander with a round pad moving in orbit and rotation.

name: Belt sander
definition: sander with a continuous abrasive belt over two rollers.

name: Polisher
definition: power tool with a soft pad or mop that rotates to polish a surface.

name: Router
definition: power tool with a bit spinning in a base, for edges, grooves and recesses.

name: Spindle moulder
definition: stationary machine with a vertical spindle and cutter for moulding profiles.

name: CNC router
definition: computer-controlled gantry machine that routes along programmed paths.

name: Wood lathe
definition: machine that turns timber between centres or on a chuck against hand-held tools.

name: Metal lathe
definition: machine that turns metal with a fixed cutting tool on a carriage.

name: Milling machine
definition: machine that cuts metal with a rotating multi-tooth cutter against a movable table.

name: Reloading press
definition: lever-operated press that holds dies to resize, prime and seat components of ammunition cartridges.

name: Wire brush
definition: brush with steel or brass wire bristles to clean or abrade surfaces before work.

name: Paintbrush
definition: brush for applying paint, varnish or stain to a surface.

name: Stepladder
definition: free-standing hinged A-frame ladder.

name: Platform stepladder
definition: step ladder with a top platform to stand on.

name: Combination ladder
definition: ladder that can be set up in more than one form (step, extension, other) from one set of rails.

name: Extension ladder
definition: ladder with sliding sections that lean against a support.

name: Telescopic ladder
definition: ladder whose rungs and rails telescope into each other.

name: Trolley jack
definition: wheeled hydraulic floor jack with a lifting arm.

name: Bottle jack
definition: hydraulic jack in a vertical bottle form.

name: Axle stand
definition: stand that supports a lifted vehicle.

name: Engine hoist
definition: folding crane that lifts engines.

name: Chain hoist
definition: hand or electric hoist with a chain.

name: Winch
definition: drum and rope or cable device for pulling or lifting.

name: Sack truck
definition: upright two-wheel carrier with a toe plate for tilting and moving loads.

name: Moving dolly
definition: low platform carrier on wheels or casters.

name: Hand cart
definition: hand-pushed multi-wheel cart or trolley for goods.

name: Excavator
definition: machine with a boom, arm and bucket on a swinging house, tracked or wheeled (mini to full size).

name: Skid steer
definition: compact loader steered by skidding wheels or tracks, with a lift arm.

name: Telehandler
definition: loader with a telescopic boom.

name: Forklift
definition: truck that lifts loads on forks.

name: Site dumper
definition: machine with a tipping body for hauling material on site.

name: Plate compactor
definition: vibrating plate machine that compacts soil and aggregate.

name: Cement mixer
definition: drum machine that mixes cement, mortar or concrete.

name: Inverter generator
definition: engine-driven generator with inverter electronics for stable output.

name: Open-frame generator
definition: engine-driven generator in an open frame with a directly coupled alternator.

name: Air compressor
definition: machine that makes compressed air for tools, in a general workshop or site role.

name: Submersible pump
definition: pump that sits under water to remove or drain it.

name: Transfer pump
definition: pump that moves liquid from one container to another.

name: Tool battery
definition: rechargeable pack made for a maker's cordless tool platform.

name: Battery charger
definition: charger made for a maker's cordless tool platform.

name: Portable toolbox
definition: hand-carried box for tools.

name: Wheeled toolbox
definition: tool box on wheels with a pull handle.

name: Stackable tool case
definition: case that locks onto other cases of a system by cleats or latches.

name: Tool bag
definition: soft or hard-bodied bag made to carry tools.

name: Tool roll
definition: flexible roll-up wrap for tools.

name: Roller cabinet
definition: drawered cabinet on casters.

name: Tool kit
definition: assorted hand tools sold, standardised and compared as one object.

name: Dust extractor
definition: extraction unit for dust from workshop machines and power tools.

name: Fume extractor
definition: unit that draws away soldering or welding fumes.

name: Drill bit
definition: cutting bit for a drill.

name: Screwdriver bit
definition: screwdriving bit for a drill or driver.

name: Saw blade
definition: toothed blade made for a saw.

name: Grinder disc
definition: disc cut for a grinder.

name: Sanding sheet or disc
definition: sheet or disc shaped to fit one sander.

name: Welding wire
definition: wire electrode for wire-fed welding.

name: Welding rod
definition: coated or bare rod for stick or TIG welding.

name: Solder
definition: fusible alloy for soldering.

name: Reloading die
definition: die for a reloading press.

name: Back saw
definition: push-stroke hand saw whose thin blade is stiffened by a brass or steel back, for joinery cuts (tenon, dovetail, gents patterns).

name: Coping saw
definition: hand saw with a thin, fine blade tensioned in a deep U-shaped frame, turned in the frame to cut curves in wood.

name: Vertical panel saw
definition: wall-standing frame machine whose circular saw runs on a vertical guide to cut full sheets held upright.

name: Reciprocating saw
definition: hand-held power saw with a long blade driven back and forth in line with the body, for demolition and rough cuts.

name: Track saw
definition: circular saw whose blade plunges down from a sprung housing and that runs on a guide rail for straight sheet cuts.

name: Cut-off saw
definition: hand-held engine or electric saw with a large abrasive or diamond disc behind a guard, for concrete, stone and steel.

name: Contractor table saw
definition: table saw on an open stand with the motor hung behind the table, between jobsite and hybrid types.

name: Straight-line rip saw
definition: industrial machine whose chain-driven bed feeds boards past a fixed blade to rip a straight edge.

name: Kataba saw
definition: Japanese pull saw with teeth on one edge only and no back, for deeper crosscuts and rips than a dozuki allows.

name: Keyhole saw
definition: narrow pointed hand saw blade on a handle, for starting cuts from a drilled hole or cutting plasterboard.

name: Bow saw
definition: saw with a coarse blade tensioned in a bow or H frame, for crosscutting logs and timber.

name: Kindling splitter
definition: cast-iron frame with a fixed upward blade, into which a small log is struck with a hammer to split kindling.

name: Detail sander
definition: hand-held sander with a small triangular (delta) pad that vibrates, for corners and narrow areas.

name: Sheet sander
definition: hand-held sander with a rectangular pad moving in small orbits, taking a cut-down abrasive sheet.

name: Drywall sander
definition: sander with a large round head on a long pole and dust extraction, for plasterboard walls and ceilings.

name: Spindle sander
definition: bench machine with an abrasive sleeve on a spindle that rotates and moves up and down through a table, for curves.

name: Belt and disc sander
definition: bench machine combining a sanding belt and a sanding disc on one motor.

name: Wall chaser
definition: hand-held machine with twin diamond discs that cuts parallel channels in masonry for cables and pipes.

name: Biscuit jointer
definition: hand-held power tool that plunges a small circular blade sideways to cut slots for joining biscuits.

name: Router table
definition: table with a router mounted beneath its top and a fence, holding the work to be passed over the bit.

name: Magnetic drill
definition: portable drill press on an electromagnetic base that clamps to steel, usually with annular cutters.

name: Hand drill
definition: hand-cranked geared drill with a side wheel and a chuck, for small holes.

name: Pipe wrench
definition: heavy adjustable wrench with a hook jaw and serrated teeth that bite round pipe.

name: Basin wrench
definition: long-shafted wrench with a pivoting jaw for tap and fitting nuts behind basins.

name: Box spanner
definition: tubular spanner with hexagon ends, turned by a bar through a hole.

name: Block plane
definition: small one-hand plane with a low-angle bevel-up blade, for end grain and chamfers.

name: Shoulder plane
definition: narrow plane whose blade spans the full width of the sole, for trimming rebates and tenon shoulders.

name: Router plane
definition: plane with a cutter hung below a flat base, for levelling grooves and recesses to depth.

name: Plough plane
definition: plane with a fence and depth stop and interchangeable narrow cutters, for grooves along the grain.

name: Rasp
definition: steel bar or blade with individually raised teeth, for fast shaping of wood and soft materials.

name: Lathe-mill
definition: metal lathe with a milling head on a column over the bed, one machine for turning and milling.

name: Club hammer
definition: short-handled heavy double-faced hammer for driving chisels and light demolition.

name: Brick hammer
definition: hammer with a square striking face and a chisel blade, for cutting and setting bricks.

name: Ball-pein hammer
definition: engineer's hammer with a flat face and a rounded pein, for metalwork and riveting.

name: Cross-pein hammer
definition: hammer with a flat face and a wedge-shaped pein across the handle, for starting pins and tacks.

name: Slater's hammer
definition: roofer's hammer with a pointed pick, a side nail claw and a blade for cutting and holing slates.

name: Sledgehammer
definition: long-handled heavy hammer swung with both hands, for demolition and driving stakes.

name: Punch
definition: hardened steel rod struck with a hammer to mark centres, drive pins or set nails.

name: Nail puller
definition: short bar with a claw tip driven under a nail head to lever it out.

name: Pry bar
definition: thin flat steel bar with bevelled ends and nail slots, for prising trim and boards.

name: Lifting bar
definition: long heavy straight bar with a chisel or point end, used as a lever to lift slabs and heavy items.

name: Plasma cutter
definition: machine that cuts metal with an electric arc through a constricted gas jet, sold and compared with welders.

name: Gas torch
definition: hand-held butane or propane torch for soldering, brazing and heating in trade and repair work.

name: Saw stand
definition: folding or wheeled stand that holds a mitre or table saw at working height, often with outrigger supports.

name: Line laser
definition: self-levelling laser projecting horizontal and vertical lines for setting out.

name: Rotary laser
definition: laser with a spinning head that sweeps a 360-degree level plane, read by a detector on site.

name: Optical level
definition: telescope on a tripod that sights a level line onto a staff, for site levels.

name: Angle finder
definition: dial, bevel or digital gauge that measures and transfers angles.

name: Stud, pipe and cable detector
definition: handheld device that senses studs, metal pipes or live cables behind a surface.

name: Moisture meter
definition: instrument that measures moisture in timber or building materials.

name: Infrared thermometer
definition: handheld non-contact thermometer that reads surface temperature from infrared radiation.

name: Inspection camera
definition: camera on a flexible probe with a screen, for looking inside walls, pipes and machines.

name: Sound level meter
definition: instrument that measures sound pressure level in decibels.

name: Clamp meter
definition: electrical meter whose jaws close round a conductor to measure current without breaking the circuit.

name: Oscilloscope
definition: instrument that displays electrical signals as waveforms, handheld or bench (ScopeMeter is a Fluke name).

name: Single ladder
definition: one-section ladder leaned against a support.

name: Roof ladder
definition: ladder with wheels and a ridge hook, laid on a pitched roof.

name: Tripod ladder
definition: ladder with a single rear leg forming a tripod, for uneven ground and hedges.

name: Engine stand
definition: wheeled stand that holds an engine by its block and lets it rotate for rebuild work.

name: Transmission jack
definition: jack with a saddle that lifts and holds a gearbox for removal and fitting.

name: Scissor jack
definition: jack lifted by a screw closing a diamond of linked arms.

name: Backhoe loader
definition: wheeled machine with a front loader bucket and a rear digging arm.

name: Pallet truck
definition: hand-pulled or powered low truck whose forks slide under a pallet and lift it just clear of the floor.

name: Tool chest
definition: drawered or lidded top box for tools, set on a bench or roller cabinet.

name: Site box
definition: large lockable steel box for storing tools on site or in a van.

name: Tool pouch
definition: belt-worn pouch or holder carrying tools and fixings at hand.

name: Surface pump
definition: surface-mounted general-purpose pump that draws water and delivers it under pressure.

name: Tungsten electrode
definition: non-consumable tungsten rod held in a TIG torch to carry the arc.

name: Brazing rod
definition: filler alloy rod or wire for brazing joints.

name: Flux
definition: paste, liquid or powder that cleans joint surfaces for soldering or brazing.
